description:
A swap's live status: waiting (for the deposit), confirming, exchanging, sending, finished, failed,
refunding, refunded, expired, verifying (held for an ID check), action_required or unknown. instructions is
the next step, for the user. Read it again after poll_after seconds, not sooner (each read asks the
exchange), until is_final.
name: get_swap
title: Get swap status
